Apple carrot oat muffins

Almás-répás zabmuffin

8 months+ Sound idea 25 min 8 portions

Serve a soft muffin, broken up if the piece is large. There is no honey and no sugar in the mix.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 medium Eating apple (Peeled and grated)
  • 1 medium Carrot (Finely grated)
  • 1 Egg (Baked until set)
  • 120 g Rolled oats (Fine or ordinary)
  • 2 tablespoons Mild oil (Rapeseed or sunflower)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mix the apple, carrot, egg, oats, and oil.
  3. Spoon into eight small cases.
  4. Bake until soft and the egg is fully set, about 18 minutes.
  5. Cool until warm and serve the same day or freeze.

Sound idea

Honey and sugar are sometimes added to fruit muffins, and neither is used. The egg must be fully cooked.

Bake apple, carrot, egg, oats, and a little oil until the muffins are soft and the egg is set.
